sans.purpose: Body, action labels, notes and interface labels.

heading.purpose: Page heading, panel headings and brand.

mono.purpose: Expressions, registers, instructions and numeric outputs.

motion.name: action-background
motion.purpose: Observed button background transition; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Compile action
components.description: Filled action for explicit compilation; the source-panel instance expands to full width and 42px minimum height.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 35px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); border: 1px solid transparent; font: 600 12px var(--font-sans); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .46; } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } } .ds-primary { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-surface); } .ds-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { filter: brightness(.88); }

components.name: Outline action
components.description: Secondary actions such as exporting current compiler output.
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 35px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); border: 1px solid transparent; font: 600 12px var(--font-sans); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .46; } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } } .ds-outline { border-color: var(--color-border); background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); } .ds-outline:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--color-primary-soft); border-color: var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Quiet action
components.css: .ds-button { display: inline-flex; gap: 8px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 35px; padding: 7px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); border: 1px solid transparent; font: 600 12px var(--font-sans); white-space: nowrap; cursor: pointer; transition: background .15s; } .ds-button:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .46; } .ds-button:active:not(:disabled) { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button { transition: none; } } .ds-quiet { color: var(--color-ink); background: transparent; } .ds-quiet:hover:not(:disabled) { background: var(--color-background); }

components.name: Source well
components.description: Persistent navy source textarea with a visible focus-within ring. Inline diagnostics belong below the well.
components.html: float32Ctrl + Enter
components.css: .ds-editor { background: var(--color-editor); border-radius: var(--radius-control); color: var(--color-editor-ink); overflow: hidden; } .ds-caption { display: block; font: 11px var(--font-mono); padding: 15px 13px 0; color: var(--color-editor-ink); opacity: .75; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-source { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 155px; resize: none; border: none; padding: 13px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-editor-ink); caret-color: var(--color-editor-ink); font: 12px/1.9 var(--font-mono); tab-size: 2; } .ds-editor:focus-within { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-source:focus-visible { outline: none; } .ds-editor-footer { display: flex; justify-content: space-between; padding: 8px 13px; font: 11px var(--font-sans); border-top: 1px solid var(--color-muted); color: var(--color-editor-ink); }

components.name: Compiler stage navigation
components.description: Horizontal stage buttons retain selected state with aria-pressed; overflow scrolls on narrow screens.
components.css: .ds-pipeline { display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 8px; gap: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-DEFAULT); background: var(--color-surface); overflow: auto; } .ds-stage { display: flex; flex: 1; align-items: center; text-align: left; gap: 12px; background: transparent; color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid transparent; padding: 10px 16px; border-radius: var(--radius-control); min-width: 144px; font: 600 14px var(--font-sans); cursor: pointer; } .ds-stage-note { display: block; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 400; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--color-muted); } .ds-index { width: 28px; height: 28px; display: grid; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: 50%; font: 400 12px var(--font-mono); } .ds-stage[aria-pressed=true] { background: var(--color-primary-soft); color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-stage[aria-pressed=true] .ds-index { background: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-surface); border-color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-stage:hover { background: var(--color-background); } .ds-stage:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-stage:active { translate: 0 1px; }

components.name: Preview status badges
components.description: Static CPU status and stale-source labels. Stale output remains visible while exports are disabled.
components.html: CPU previewSource changed
components.css: .ds-badges { display: flex; gap: 8px; flex-wrap: wrap; } .ds-badge { font: 11px var(--font-sans); background: var(--color-primary-soft); color: var(--color-primary); border-radius: var(--radius-control); padding: 3px 7px; } .ds-stale { color: var(--color-comparison); background: var(--color-background); }

components.name: Instrument panel
components.description: Flat white panel with a thin divider and no shadow; the example uses inspector padding.
components.html:
Compiler inspector

Trace output back to source.

Select a stage to inspect its representation.
components.css: .ds-panel { background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-DEFAULT); min-width: 0; font: 14px/1.5 var(--font-sans); } .ds-panel-heading { padding: 21px 24px 17px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); } .ds-panel-title { margin: 0; font: 600 17px var(--font-heading); letter-spacing: -.015em; } .ds-panel-note { margin: 5px 0 0; color: var(--color-muted); font-size: 11px; } .ds-panel-body { padding: 21px 24px; }

components.name: AST node
components.description: Compact keyboard-operable source-linked node. Pixel input uses the teal selected treatment.
components.html: <button class="ds-node ds-pixel" aria-label="Pixel input, source range 0 to 5">pixel</button>
components.css: .ds-node { width: 84px; height: 38px; background: var(--color-surface); color: var(--color-ink); border: 1px solid var(--color-border); border-radius: var(--radius-control); font: 12px var(--font-mono); cursor: pointer; } .ds-node:hover, .ds-node:focus-visible { border-color: var(--color-primary); background: var(--color-primary-soft); } .ds-node:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-node:active { translate: 0 1px; } .ds-node.ds-pixel { background: var(--color-primary-soft); border-color: var(--color-primary); color: var(--color-primary); }

components.name: Float32 trace row
components.description: Register, operation and aligned output share one selectable row; current instruction is filled softly.
components.css: .ds-trace { display: grid; width: 100%; grid-template-columns: 55px minmax(0,1fr) 85px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; text-align: left; color: var(--color-ink); background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--color-border); padding: 10px; font: 12px var(--font-mono); cursor: pointer; } .ds-trace:hover { background: var(--color-background); } .ds-trace.ds-current { background: var(--color-primary-soft); } .ds-register, .ds-result { color: var(--color-primary); } .ds-result { text-align: right; font-family: var(--font-mono); } .ds-operation { overflow-wrap: anywhere; } .ds-trace:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--color-primary); outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-trace:active { translate: 0 1px; }

narrative.overview:
Product register: a local engineering workbench for exploring image filters and compiler stages. Its reference is a digital imaging test instrument: calibrated input and output, a visible signal path, and a probe that traces one value. English technical vocabulary follows the compiler. The memorable interaction is selecting a compiler node or instruction and tracing it back to the source and through float32 registers.

Assumed visual direction, chosen for legibility while presenting: pale slate workspace, white instrument surfaces, a navy source well, teal for active execution, and rust for before/after comparison. Avoid marketing hero layouts, invented benchmarks, neon GPU branding, and decorative charts.
dos: Show actual C++ compilation output and actual instruction counts.
Keep execution backend and verification scope visible.
Preserve entered source on errors and ignore stale async results.
donts: Do not imply NVIDIA execution from a successful offline assembly.
Do not claim fewer PTX instructions automatically improve GPU performance.
